# Shadleaf

> shadcn/ui for Thymeleaf, as a Spring Boot starter. Components are Thymeleaf tags with the `sl:` prefix
> (`<sl:button variant="outline">`), rendered on the server. Not React: no JSX, no Radix, no `asChild`.

These docs describe Shadleaf 0.8.0-SNAPSHOT. The docs of other versions live next to this one, at /shadleaf/<version>/.

Read "Using Shadleaf with coding agents" first: it lists the rules an agent most often gets wrong. Every component
page ends with its attribute table (props, allowed values, defaults); the examples are the Thymeleaf source to write.

## Start here

- [Shadleaf](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/index.md): shadcn/ui for Thymeleaf, as a Spring Boot starter.
- [Getting started](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/getting-started.md): Add Shadleaf to a Spring Boot application.
- [Coming from shadcn/ui](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/coming-from-shadcn.md): What carries over from shadcn/ui unchanged, and where Shadleaf differs, and why.
- [IDE completion](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/ide-completion.md): Completion for sl:* tags, their attributes and values in IntelliJ IDEA and WebStorm.
- [Using Shadleaf with coding agents](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/coding-agents.md): Point Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents at these docs, and give them the rules they get wrong.

## Components

- [Accordion](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/accordion.md): A stack of sections, each with a heading that shows or hides its content, on the browser's details element.
- [Alert](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/alert.md): A callout for a message the user should notice.
- [Alert Dialog](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/alert-dialog.md): A modal dialog that interrupts the user with something important and waits for an answer.
- [Avatar](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/avatar.md): A picture of a person, with initials when there is no picture.
- [Badge](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/badge.md): A small label for a status, a count or a category.
- [Breadcrumb](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/breadcrumb.md): The trail of pages above the one shown now, with a menu for the levels a long trail leaves out.
- [Button](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/button.md): A button, or a link that looks like one.
- [Card](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/card.md): A container for related content and actions, built from its parts.
- [Checkbox](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/checkbox.md): The browser's own checkbox, styled, bound to a form field with th:field.
- [Collapsible](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/collapsible.md): Content that a button shows and hides, on the browser's details element.
- [Dialog](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/dialog.md): A modal window over the page, on the native dialog element.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/dropdown-menu.md): A menu of actions or links that opens from a button, on the browser's Popover API.
- [Field](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/field.md): A label, a control, a description and the binding's error messages, wired together from one th:field.
- [Form errors](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/form-errors.md): The errors that belong to the whole form rather than one field, or all of the form's errors, read from the binding and shown above the fields.
- [Icon](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/icon.md): Inline SVG icons from lucide, or your own.
- [Input](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/input.md): A text input, bound to a form field with th:field.
- [Kbd](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/kbd.md): A key on the keyboard, or a combination of keys.
- [Label](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/label.md): A label for a form control.
- [Pagination](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/pagination.md): Links to the other pages of a list, built from the Spring Data Page the controller returns.
- [Popover](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/popover.md): Rich content in a panel next to the button that opens it, on the browser's Popover API.
- [Query params](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/query-params.md): Hidden inputs that keep a table's order, page size and filters when a search form is sent.
- [Radio Group](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/radio-group.md): A set of the browser's own radio buttons, styled, bound to a form field with th:field.
- [Select](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/select.md): shadcn/ui's Select on a real select element, bound with th:field; the browser's customizable select where it has one.
- [Select (Native)](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/select-native.md): The browser's own select, styled, bound to a form field with th:field.
- [Separator](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/separator.md): A thin line between content.
- [Sheet](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/sheet.md): A dialog that slides in from an edge of the screen.
- [Sidebar](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/sidebar.md): The application's navigation beside the page, and a panel over it on a phone.
- [Site Header](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/site-header.md): A header bar across the top of the page, or at the top of the sidebar layout's page.
- [Skeleton](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/skeleton.md): A placeholder that pulses while content loads.
- [Skip Link](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/skip-link.md): A link past the navigation to the page's content, for keyboard users.
- [Switch](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/switch.md): An on/off control, bound to a boolean form field with th:field.
- [Table](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/table.md): A table in shadcn/ui's look, whose column headers sort it on the server.
- [Tabs](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/tabs.md): Panels of content shown one at a time, chosen from a row of tabs.
- [Textarea](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/textarea.md): A multi-line text input, bound to a form field with th:field.
- [Theme Toggle](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/theme-toggle.md): Switches the page between the light and the dark theme, and remembers the choice in the browser.
- [Toast](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/toast.md): A short message in a corner of the page that closes itself, sent by the server; shadcn/ui's Sonner.
- [Tooltip](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/tooltip.md): A short text that shows while the pointer rests on an element or the keyboard focuses it.
- [User Menu](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/components/user-menu.md): The signed-in user with a menu that signs out, or a Sign in link, for the sidebar's footer or the site header.

## Guides

- [The adjustability ladder](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/guides/adjustability.md): Five ways to make the components your own, from a prop to owning the template.
- [Content-Security-Policy](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/guides/csp.md): Run Shadleaf under a strict CSP, with a nonce or a hash, and no 'unsafe-inline'.
- [Spring Security](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/guides/spring-security.md): The one matcher the library's assets need, the signed-in user in templates (#slUser), and htmx requests after the session expired.
- [Signing in with OAuth2](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/guides/oauth2.md): Keycloak (OpenID Connect, signing out at Keycloak too) and GitHub as the way users sign in, and what the user menu shows for each.
- [Alpine.js](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/guides/alpine.md): Let Shadleaf bring Alpine, use its CSP build, or register with the Alpine your application already loads.
- [Forms with htmx](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/guides/htmx.md): Post a Shadleaf form with htmx, get it back with its errors without a page load, and keep it working as a plain POST.
- [Tables with htmx](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/guides/tables-htmx.md): Search as you type, sort and page a server-side table with htmx, act on a row from its menu, load more rows, keep the focus and the back button, and keep it working without JavaScript.
- [Application shell](https://wimdeblauwe.github.io/shadleaf/0.8.0-SNAPSHOT/guides/application-shell.md): Two layouts to copy for the frame around every page, a sidebar or the navigation in a header, and what every layout needs whichever you pick.
